title: Seven AI — CORE_UI_REFERENCE_DATABASE
methodology: 200 pattern-level reference units, split 50/50/50/50 across the four required research buckets.
Sources mix shipped AI/productivity products, mobile design guidance, and accessibility standards.
References are used to extract patterns; Seven must not clone any single product.
Visual decisions require local screenshots before READY.
